leads.name: Pu Krang, the giant council tree of Silpakorn University
leads.species: Council Tree (Ficus altissima), from the Thai name krang

location.address: Silpakorn University Wang Tha Phra, 31 Thanon Na Phra Lan, in front of the Faculty of Archaeology

leads.reason: campus: no source read says the grounds are open to visitors (hard rule 10, schools); travel articles list the tree as a visit but the university's own page says nothing; lifecheck NONE, no iNaturalist observation of it
leads.notes: Register: girth about 15 m (implausible for one trunk, a spreading aerial-root mass or corrupt column), height about 25 m, age not given, 'over a hundred years, planted early Rattanakosin before the palace became the university'. The Cloud (readthecloud.com/travel/take-me-out/tree-rattanakosin-island, fetched, undated): trunk base as wide as eight people embracing it, over 100 years, among the largest trees in Bangkok, in an old photograph from Rama IV. Spacebar 2024-06-22 and The Standard 2020-10-21 both name it in front of the Faculty of Archaeology. Free art gallery at Wang Tha Phra per non-official sources. To ship: one line from the university or a dated visit saying the campus is open, and a dated photograph.

leads.name: Kaeo Chao Chom orange jasmine, Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University
leads.species: Orange Jasmine (Murraya paniculata), per Thai name; the register text talks of a Lignum Vitae from Java, so species is unclear
leads.reason: campus access not evidenced; species conflict (kaeo vs Guaiacum); small tree, girth 2 m, height 15 m, about 100 years, flowers the university's flower
leads.notes: point 13.775673,100.508269, behind the Phra Nang mound memorial; no life check run

leads.name: Lamphu (mangrove apple) stand of Bang Krasop
leads.reason: a group of about 1,700 replanted trees (restored from 2008) on 41 rai, not an individual old tree; register gives girth 2.53 m and height 25 m for the group; in Samut Prakan (Phra Pradaeng, Bang Krachao area), within day-trip range but no individual to place; Bang Krasop is the Bang Krachao green lung and a firefly site

leads.name: Thammasat bodhi tree (register 2017-23)
leads.note: Same tree as live bkk_005 (Lan Pho, Thammasat). Register point 13.765097,100.490946 is about 1 km north of bkk_005 pin 13.7568,100.4917, so the register coordinate is wrong or points at a different campus site; keep the bkk_005 pin. Register gives no age ('nearly a hundred years', older than the university founded 1934), no measurements.
